ignore.reason: Options is a bag of independent run inputs; paths, rules and typecheck each mean what they mean here, and renaming them to dodge an upstream field of the same name would make them worse names
IgnoreRule is the on-disk config format; its rule/path/reason field names are the contract every repository writes, so they are not renamed for a review notice
Test doubles and the plan engine are parallel interfaces by design; Questionnaire.read and Planned.read are each read by their own caller, and plan/plans/id name the seam the engine is built on
Store and PlanAnswers are two views of one cache; get and put are the same operations over different stored shapes, and the parallelism is what makes them checkable against each other
Report is the stored-run wire schema; files (a count) and notes (rule notes) would need a version bump to rename, for a name that reads correctly in the report it describes
ReportInput.score and ClusterVerdict.score are one concept the rule wants shared; reconciling them is a required-key change across forty call sites, which is a real refactor and not a rename

evidence.repository: joggle analyses other repositories and reports diagnostics; it does not render. There is no React here, so the composition-pattern rules are only meaningful when run against a codebase that does render.
